blackwell-tp2-static.description: Blackwell: TP2 written out, static compile, FlashInfer attention (the measured Blackwell backend for static image shapes).
blackwell-tp2-static.upstream_recipe_reason: recipes/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo.md (62ebad2d7cd7) has only an Intel XPU offline section; the layout follows docs/user_guide/diffusion tensor_parallel.md (TP=2 only) and sequence_parallel.md.

default.description: Best known LightX2V command/config for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.
default.notes: Uses explicit fast attention/offload settings; no cache, torch compile, or quantized model path.

blackwell-fa2.description: Blackwell LightX2V profile using FlashAttention 2 (validated on B200 via the flux2 blackwell-fa2-flashinfer profile). Same precision class (full-precision, exact attention) as SGLang's FA4 and vLLM-Omni's FlashInfer backend on Blackwell -- flash_attn3/flash_attn4 hit Hopper-only precompiled kernels or a CUDA-toolkit>=13.1 CuTe-DSL requirement not met by this build, so FA2 is the fastest same-class (full-precision) option available here.
blackwell-fa2.notes: 2026-10-22: like the H200 profile, it had no parallel block, so two ranks each computed the whole image; now Ulysses 2 as upstream's dist config, FA2 (FA3 is Hopper-only). VALIDATION PENDING (round 2026-10-22, 4xB300).

h200-fa3-flashinfer.description: H200 fastest available LightX2V command/config for aligned non-cache benchmark runs.
h200-fa3-flashinfer.notes: 2026-10-22: the config had no parallel block, so torchrun's two ranks each computed the whole image (worker.py only calls init_parallel when config['parallel'] is set) and every earlier row measured one GPU on two. Now Ulysses 2 as upstream's dist config. use_compile is ignored by ZImageTransformerInfer. VALIDATION PENDING (round 2026-10-22, 2xH200/4xH200).

h200-gpuonly.description: H200: --gpu-only, so TorchCompileModel runs (dynamic VRAM's malloc graph breaks it).
h200-gpuonly.notes: Placement only. Workflow sampler is res_multistep, as the official image_z_image_turbo template (was euler, same cost per step). VALIDATION PENDING (round 2026-10-22, 2xH200/4xH200).

default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Official 'Text to Image (Z-Image-Turbo)' blueprint at the case's 9 steps (sglang's progress bar reads 9/9 per request). euler instead of the blueprint's res_multistep: the same one forward per step, and closer to the flow-matching Euler (shift 3) the other rows run. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case. Compile on: the core TorchCompileModel node (inductor) goes behind every diffusion-model loader, as the other competitors run compile-on; measured on FLUX.1 / 1xB200 2026-09-25 at 4.89s against 5.94s and 5.77s eager.

blackwell-gpuonly.description: Blackwell: the default graph with every model resident on the GPU (--gpu-only).
blackwell-gpuonly.notes: B200: --gpu-only keeps every model, text encoders included, stored and run on the card; a 183 GB B200 holds the largest graph here (MiniMax-H3: 62 GB DiT + 48 GB Qwen3-VL-32B + VAEs). Placement only, numerics unchanged. Measured 2026-09-25 on 1xB200, FLUX.1 eager, interleaved arms: default 5.94 / 5.77 / 5.79s against --gpu-only 5.56s and --gpu-only --disable-dynamic-vram 5.57s (Qwen-Image-2.1: 3.75 / 3.91 against 3.47 / 3.48) -- every --gpu-only arm below every default arm; disabling dynamic VRAM on top adds nothing, so the simpler flag is kept.
